plan.title: Knowledge plan
plan.explanation: Review the document outline or inferred page topics, then edit the topic × cognitive matrix. Chapters are matched or created only when approved questions are saved to the bank.
plan.error: Operation failed or the revision changed. Reopen this plan to reload its latest state; retain any unsaved edits first.
plan.sourceHint: Source format: PAGE:1, PAGE:2 or SLIDE:3, NOTES:3. Use only units present in this document. Parent selection supports arbitrary depth; cycles are rejected.
plan.name: Chapter name
plan.heading: Extracted heading
plan.matrixStale: The chapter list changed, so the topic × cognitive-level matrix may no longer match. Rebuild it to get the full batch size; rows of deleted chapters are dropped and hand-edited objectives/counts are regenerated.
plan.matrixMismatch: The matrix has {total} questions but the batch requires {target}. Rebuild the matrix or adjust the counts.
plan.total: {total}/20 questions · {uncovered} leaf topics without a matrix row
plan.reviewWarning: Suggestions use document headings and page text. Review inferred topics, sources and objectives. Cognitive level and answer correctness remain unassessed. Only branches needed by selected approved questions are created, atomically with those questions.
plan.invalid: Check the tree, source units, objectives and total of 1–20 questions.
plan.generateNewHint: Create a new batch of drafts from the same plan and document without re-uploading or re-indexing.

errors.PLAN_OUTLINE_INVALID: The AI-proposed chapter/topic tree was invalid (for example duplicate topic names). Prepare again; duplicate names are now disambiguated. Plans never retry on page load.
errors.PLAN_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The source document is not ready: extraction must finish, or a partial extraction must be confirmed in the document library.
errors.PLAN_SOURCE_TIMEOUT: The document was not ready within the wait window (20 minutes). Check its extraction status, then prepare again.
errors.PLAN_SCOPE_REVOKED: Access to the document was revoked; the plan cannot be prepared again.

title: AI question generation
description: Attach a learning document to generate questions from its content, then review and approve each draft before adding it to the bank.

existing.label: Library document version
existing.pickTopic: Choose a topic to see its uploaded documents.
existing.error: Could not load the document library. Please try again later.
existing.empty: This topic has no uploaded documents. Upload a new one or add it in the library.
existing.hint: Only extracted or processing versions can be selected. OCR-required, failed or unfinished uploads are locked. Reusing a document skips upload, extraction and document indexing.

fileHint: Attach one text-layer PDF or PPTX, up to 20 MB. The system extracts and indexes it before generating questions. Scanned content requires OCR and is not supported yet.
focusPlaceholder: For example: stacks, LIFO and their applications

preparationStage.INDEXING: Preparing source: creating the retrieval index…
preparationStage.READY: Source ready; waiting for question generation…

citationsHint: Quotes were checked against retrieved excerpts when generated. They do not prove that the question or answer is correct; check the evidence before approval.
citationsEdited: This draft has been edited. Evidence from the original generation is retained; check whether it still supports the edited question and answer.
sourcePlaceholder: Paste the knowledge passage to base the questions on…

config.title: Question configuration
config.hint: Questions are generated in row order. Up to {rows} rows and {max} questions per run. Multiple-choice questions have 2–3 correct answers.

consent: I have permission to use this document and consent to processing, storing and sending its content and my knowledge focus to Google for embedding and question generation.
invalidCommand: Choose a topic, attach a PDF/PPTX up to 20 MB, configure up to 20 rows totalling 1-20 questions and consent to AI processing.
targetError: Topics/chapters could not be loaded. Reload the page to retry.
queued: Plan created. Source preparation is running.
emptyDescription: Create a batch above or open a recent batch to continue reviewing.
loadError: Data could not be loaded, or access is no longer available. Reload to check.
processing: The batch is processing. This page updates automatically; you can return later.
failed: Generation failed. Check the configuration or create a new batch after resolving the issue.

insufficientEvidence.title: Not enough source evidence to generate questions
insufficientEvidence.explanation: The retrieved content does not sufficiently support the requested learning objectives, question types or cognitive levels. This is an evidence limitation, not an invalid JSON response or a provider configuration error.
insufficientEvidence.unknownSlots: The service did not identify which question slots failed. Do not assume that a particular plan row or question failed.

reasons.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: The retrieved evidence cannot support this request.
reasons.NO_RETRIEVED_CONTEXT: No relevant source context was retrieved for this request.

insufficientEvidence.action: Review the plan's objectives, question types and cognitive levels; check the relevant source pages/slides or choose a better source, and consider reducing the requested count before explicitly creating a new batch.
insufficientEvidence.noDrafts: This batch remains failed. No drafts were created or saved to the question bank, and generation will not retry automatically.

completed: This batch is complete. Saved questions show their bank IDs below.
reviewHint: AI can make mistakes. Check the content, answers and cognitive level before approving. Only approved, selected questions are saved.

optionsHint.SINGLE_CHOICE: Four distinct choices · Select exactly one correct answer
optionsHint.MULTIPLE_CHOICE: Four distinct choices · Select two or three correct answers

invalidDraft: Enter question text (up to 2,000 characters), four distinct choices (up to 500 characters each) and exactly one correct answer (single choice) or two to three (multiple choice).
editResetsApproval: Saving an edit clears the previous approval. Approve the new revision before adding it to the bank.
conflict: The draft changed or its state no longer permits this action. Fresh data has been requested; check it before continuing.
actionError: The action has not been confirmed. Check the latest state before retrying; do not create another batch while waiting for a result.
confirmTitle: Add approved questions to the bank?
confirmDescription: Save {count} selected questions into this batch's chapter. Other drafts are unchanged. You have checked their content and answers.
committed: Selected questions were saved to the bank.
